title: FORGE CLI envelope
description: The one JSON document every in-scope FORGE command prints in `--json` mode (#475). `forge schema <command>` prints this document with `properties.data` replaced by that command's payload schema.

status.description: Terminal status of the command; `pending` is for paths that stop and wait (approval gate, needs input).

command.description: Subcommand that produced the document (`check`, `run`, `wake`, ...), or the subcommand named in argv for a usage error, or `""` when none was given.

data.description: Command payload, filterable with `--fields`. One `<command>.data.schema.json` describes each command's shape; see `forge schema <command>`.

context.description: One human sentence describing what happened.

next_steps.description: Concrete commands to run next (`forge explain <code>` for check errors).

warnings.description: Non-fatal findings, also present in `data.diagnostics` for `check`.

cost.description: USD spent by this command. `0.0` on paths with no LLM calls, `null` when spend cannot be measured.

error.description: `null` on success and on warnings-only runs, else the error taxonomy.

type.description: Error taxonomy. `io`, `parse`, `config` and `runtime` are classified from the failure; `usage` is an invalid command line, `check` is static diagnostics blocking execution, `unsupported` is a command without a JSON contract.

code.description: Diagnostic code (`E020`) when the failure carries one.

suggestion.description: Concrete next action, e.g. `run forge check --help`.
